name: TextOverImageLightning
headline: TextOverImageLightning: Marketing Cloud Block
short_description: A sample Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder block built with the blocksdk, demonstrating how to create custom content blocks for email marketing campaigns.
author: tristonwilliams

sections.overview:
TextOverImageLightning is a sample content block for Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder that uses the official blocksdk framework. It provides a starting point for developers building custom blocks to extend Marketing Cloud's native functionality. The block can be deployed as a Node.js application or directly to Heroku with one-click deployment. Developers can clone the repository, customize the markup, logic, and configuration, then test locally before deploying. This template streamlines the process of creating reusable content blocks for email marketing workflows.
Creating custom email content blocks for Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Building branded or specialized content components for campaigns
Extending Marketing Cloud Content Builder with proprietary block designs
Testing and prototyping new content block functionality
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/tristonwilliams/TextOverImageLightning`
sections.usage:
```
Create a TextOverImageLightning content block for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use the following [DATA] to generate a compelling visual with overlaid text. The image should be [IMAGE_DESCRIPTION] and the text should be [TEXT_CONTENT]. Ensure the design aligns with [COMPANY]'s brand guidelines, including colors, fonts, and overall aesthetic.
```
